newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE shares mixed on Beirut bourse.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE shares mixed on Beirut bourse.

text.p: SOLIDERE shares were mixed on Tuesday on the Beirut Stock exchange (BSE).
A shares remained unchanged from Monday's close of $110, while B shares dropped to $109.750 from $111.
Turnover was 2,951 shares down from Monday's 3,896, and the value of traded shares was $325,612.125 from $431,415.

Other shares that changed hands, were 3,000 Ciments Libanais shares for $1.3125, unchanged from Thursday when 1,000 were traded, and 1,000 Eternit shares at $1.8750 each, unchanged from September 25 when 5,530 shares were traded.
There was no trade in the shares of the two other listed companies: Ciments Blancs' and Uniceramic's.
The LISPI stock index fell 0.16 percent to 83.31 and the BLOM stock index fell 0.46 percent to 943.87.
